name: doc-studio
description: A local read model and navigator for markdown-driven projects.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @docstudio/web build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n types,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch packages/cli/dist/index.js serve fixtures/vault-demo" "corepack pnpm --filter @docstudio/web dev"
